start.speaker: Doc
start.text: You look like trouble that pays. What do you need, detective?

n1.speaker: Doc
n1.text: Say it. My waiting room isn't a place to linger.

choices.text: What do you know about Kanzaki?
Who signs this poison through customs?

analyze.speaker: Doc
analyze.text: ...This isn't waste. It's a neuroagent — a failed batch of a nerve compound Kanzaki's pharma arm buried years ago. Sunk in the harbor, it's been leaching into the low-district water for months. That's your body count, detective. Slow poison, one glass at a time.

discover.title: The Analysis
discover.desc: Doc confirms KZ-7 is a banned neuroagent from Kanzaki's pharma division, dumped in the harbor and poisoning the low districts' water. The dead reporter was about to blow it open.

kanzaki.speaker: Doc
kanzaki.text: Kanzaki? Half my patients are their cleanup. I don't ask questions, they don't burn my clinic down. That's the whole arrangement.

inspector.speaker: Doc
inspector.text: Someone signs the harbor manifests clean. Word is it's Halloran — Harbor Authority. Drinks alone on the east rooftops when the guilt gets loud. Start there.

bye.speaker: Doc
bye.text: Then stop bleeding on my floor and go.
